notes_for_reviewer: New benchmark test only (tests/benchmark/), plus docs-only RUN.md addition. No production code touched.

Test uses one deterministic DataFrame (N=2000, seed 0), same feature modes (binary/positive/ternary), same int32 chromosomes (B=64, K=3, seed 1) and same constants (config PHASE2_TP/SL/CAPITAL_PCT) for both engines.
JAX async is handled honestly: steady-state helper calls jax.block_until_ready per call; GPUBacktestEngine.simulate_rule_batch also blocks internally before returning host arrays.

GPU-only timing: monkeypatches config.PHASE2_GPU_ENRICH_SYMBOL_METRICS=False so the optional CPU per-symbol enrichment pass does not pollute GPU timings. Fairness: pins PHASE2_GPU_BATCH_SIZE env to B=64 (cache_clearing the lru-cached resolver before/after) so the GPU call processes the same 64 chromosomes with no pad-to-chunk skew; asserts resolved chunk == B.
Skips unless jax.default_backend()=='gpu' and a physical gpu-platform device is present.

Checks result list length == B, expected metric keys present, numeric metrics finite, counts non-negative. Does NOT assert GPU wins; outcome printed as informational (GPU was faster in steady-state on the local RTX 4050).
